preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard must be between 3 and 1000.
Alice's queen must be within the bounds of the chessboard.
Bob's king must be within the bounds of the chessboard.
The target position for Bob's king must be within the bounds of the chessboard.

preconditions.expression: (a_x != b_x or a_y != b_y) and (c_x != a_x or c_y != a_y) and (c_x != b_x or c_y != b_y)
preconditions.description: Bob's king, Alice's queen, and the target position must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if can_reach_without_check(n, a_x, a_y, b_x, b_y, c_x, c_y) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Bob can reach the target position without being in check.
